import numpy as np

Wpos = W['pos_embed.W_pos']  # (10, 24)
WE = W['embed.W_E']  # (13, 24)
WU = W['unembed.W_U']  # (24, 11)

def softmax(x):
    e = np.exp(x - x.max(-1, keepdims=True))
    return e / e.sum(-1, keepdims=True)

for layer in [0, 2]:
    WQ = W[f'blocks.{layer}.attn.W_Q'][0]
    WK = W[f'blocks.{layer}.attn.W_K'][0]
    bQ = W[f'blocks.{layer}.attn.b_Q'][0]
    bK = W[f'blocks.{layer}.attn.b_K'][0]
    WV = W[f'blocks.{layer}.attn.W_V'][0]
    WO = W[f'blocks.{layer}.attn.W_O'][0]

    q = Wpos @ WQ + bQ  # (10,6)
    k = Wpos @ WK + bK  # (10,6)
    qk = q @ k.T / np.sqrt(6)
    attn = softmax(qk)
    print(f"\n=== L{layer}H0 positional attention (softmax) ===")
    print(np.round(attn, 3))

    OV = WV @ WO  # (24,24)
    tok_logits = WE @ OV @ WU  # (13,11)
    print(f"\nL{layer}H0 OV: token->class argmax: {np.argmax(tok_logits[:11], axis=-1)}")
    print("Max logit per token:", np.round(tok_logits[:11].max(axis=-1), 2))
